translations.text: The Lord, the God of our fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their righteous descendants.
He who made heaven and earth with all their adornment.
He who bound the sea and held it in place by the command of his word; he who shut up the deep and sealed it with his awesome and glorious name.
You before whose power everything is afraid and trembles.
For the great splendor of your glory cannot be endured, and no one can bear to stand before your anger and your wrath against sinners.
But the mercies you have promised are boundless and immeasurable.

For you are the Lord, patient, merciful, and full of compassion, and you relent concerning the evils of humankind. You, Lord, in the kindness of your grace, promised forgiveness to those who repent of their sins. In your abundant mercy you established repentance so that sinners might live.

You, therefore, Lord, God of the righteous, did not establish repentance for the righteous, such as Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who did not sin against you. Rather, you established repentance for me, a sinner.

For my sins have become more numerous than the sand of the sea, and I have no freedom to lift my eyes because of my many wrongdoings. And now, Lord, I am justly afflicted and battered as I deserve. For here I am, bound,

and bowed down by many iron chains, so that I cannot lift my head. Indeed, I am not even worthy to lift my eyes and look and see the height of heaven, because of the great evil of my wicked deeds. For I have done evil before you, provoked your wrath, set up idols, and multiplied defilement.
And now, look, I bend the knees of my heart before you and appeal to your kindness.
I have sinned, Lord, I have sinned. And because I know my sins,

I plead before you: forgive me, Lord, and do not destroy me along with my offenses. Do not be angry with me forever, and do not hold my evil deeds against me. Do not condemn me and cast me into the depths of the earth, for you are the God of those who repent.
Therefore, my Lord, show your grace as well. Though I am unworthy, you save me in keeping with your abundant mercy.
For this reason I will praise you at all times and throughout all the days of my life, because all the hosts of heaven praise you and sing to you forever and ever.
